landing.label: Marketing landing
rules: first viewport: nav + hero only
max ONE layout family per page (Part 1b)
one CTA intent repeated verbatim
social-proof and proof sections are OMITTED when the user supplied no real names/numbers

saas-marketing.label: SaaS product marketing page
rules: honest comparison table replaces three feature cards
pricing lives on its own route unless it is a differentiator

pricing.label: Pricing page
rules: the toggle is an accessible Tabs/radio group
no layout shift on billing change
one recommended tier with a stated reason

dashboard.label: Product dashboard / admin
rules: no entrance motion
group KPIs by decision
remove 60% of card borders on the first pass

docs.label: Documentation
rules: no placeholder API names - remove the page instead
on-this-page from real headings

onboarding.label: Onboarding flow
rules: back is always possible
state persists across reload

component.label: Single component delivery
rules: all 8 states shipped
built on the accessible primitive

content.label: Blog / changelog
rules: real dates and real excerpts, or neither

auth.label: Auth screens
rules: no marketing on an auth screen
error copy never reveals account existence

error.label: Error / 404
rules: the 404 offers real paths back; a 500 keeps the user's work

mobile-app.label: Mobile app screens
rules: Reanimated on the UI thread; animate transform/opacity only
44pt minimum targets; safe areas honoured top and bottom
no web motion library in the RN bundle
native stack and native tabs - no JS tab bars

_resolutionNote: Page types resolve to an archetype by exact/normalized match against these keys first, then by keyword family: dash|admin|analytics|console|panel -> dashboard; doc -> docs; price -> pricing; component -> component; blog|article|changelog|news|post -> content; login|signin|signup|auth -> auth; 404|error -> error; land|market|home|saas|product -> landing.
